_comment: INDICATIVE timing — NOT test-validated and NOT reproducible, unlike chart-data.json. Two snapshots: `untunedMsVsRtt` is mean ms/op for the untuned shape vs injected RTT (quick OrmVsGrackleBenchmark run); `overfetchCost` is median ms/op for fetching all Person rows: Grackle projects only `firstName`, while the ORM over-fetches one extra column per panel via a purpose-built entity — `heavy` (compute), `wide` (bytes), or both — so each bar isolates a single cost (grackle.benchmarks.orm.OverfetchTiming). Wide confidence intervals; treat as the shape of the gap, not authoritative figures. Regenerate charts with `sbt benchmarksSql/generateCharts`.
